title: Still
description: Scandinavian calm: pale stone, sage and oak, light grotesque type, generous space and small framed images.

tokens.HERO_HEADLINE: An hour of quiet, and a better haircut
tokens.HERO_LEDE: Natural colour, considered cuts and scalp care, in a studio with no music and no mirrors until the end.
tokens.ABOUT_TEXT: Still is a two-chair studio that uses plant-based colour and unhurried appointments. You can talk, or not. Both are welcome.
tokens.QUOTE: Healthy hair needs very little. Mostly time.
tokens.FOOTER_BLURB: A quiet studio for natural colour, cuts and scalp care.
